sha256-fd-v1:45ae7823bf4992b53b7a7327eba.description: Two decades after nuclear strikes destroy Tokyo, survivors live in underground shelters while demons roam above. Join the Devil Busters to defend the shelters and explore the ruined city in this Megami Tensei RPG.
sha256-fd-v1:45ae7823bf4992b53b7a7327eba.title: Giten Megami Tensei: Tokyo Mokushiroku

sha256-hdi-v1:455d6639f0d3e9e5e72bfe7e89.description: Rei, a pilot in the Steel Fox squad, assaults the Slave Dog terrorist base in a heavily armed suit. Night Slave pairs side-scrolling shooting and boss fights with an animated science-fiction story.
